rules.developers: May only change task/subtask 'status' fields to 'done'
rules.architects: May add, remove, reorder, or edit any field

quickstart.reference_parser: parsers/cookware.py -- copy this when creating new parsers

tasks.title: Fix NLP ingredient parser NameError
tasks.description: parse_ingredient is imported inside get_ingredient_parser() (function scope, line 65) but referenced at module scope in NLPIngredientParser.parse() (line 41). First NLP use raises NameError.

subtasks.title: Move 'from ingredient_parser import parse_ingredient' to module-level import with try/except guard
Verify NLP parsing works: ./venv/bin/python3 convert.py tests/samples/cookware.csv -o /tmp/nlp_test.json (without --no-nlp)
Ensure --no-nlp still works and tests pass

tasks.title: Fix convert_recipe_file() multi-recipe mode -- output never written
tasks.description: The 'multiple recipes per file' fallback path in convert_recipe_file() converts recipes but never writes them to the output file. Recipes are discarded.

subtasks.title: Locate the multi-recipe fallback branch in convert_recipe_file()
Wire converted recipes into JSONStreamWriter output (match single-recipe path behavior)
Add a test sample with multiple recipes and verify output is written

tasks.title: Fix mixed.py crash when NYCParser detected in mixed file
tasks.description: mixed.py line 69 calls parser.parse_buffer(f, line) but NYCParser has no parse_buffer() method. Will raise AttributeError at runtime.

subtasks.title: Add parse_buffer(f, line) method to NYCParser (model after mealmaster.py or compuchef.py)
Add NYC section to tests/samples/mixed_test.txt and regenerate expected output
Run tests to verify mixed-format parsing with NYC content

tasks.title: Replace print() statements with logger calls in parsers
tasks.description: Production print() in compuchef.py:88 dumps full recipe text to stdout. ricette_json.py:66 prints to stderr instead of using logger.

subtasks.title: Add 'logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)' to compuchef.py module level
Replace compuchef.py:88 print() with logger.debug()
Replace ricette_json.py:66 print(..., file=sys.stderr) with logger.warning(); remove unused 'import sys'
Run tests to confirm no regressions

tasks.title: Fix -f flag: dynamically populate choices from ParserRegistry
tasks.description: convert.py line 197 hardcodes only 11 of 20+ format_ids. '20krecipes' doesn't match actual format_id 'csv_20krecipes'. Users cannot force-select most parsers.

subtasks.title: Add a method to ParserRegistry that returns all format_ids + aliases
Replace hardcoded choices list in convert.py argparse with dynamic call to registry
Add aliases to parsers that are missing them (e.g., TwentyKRecipesParser should alias '20krecipes')
Test: ./venv/bin/python3 convert.py -f csv_20krecipes tests/samples/sample_20krecipes.csv -o /tmp/test.json

tasks.title: Fix compuchef.py parse_buffer() return type annotation
tasks.description: Line 71: return type '(Optional[Recipe], int)' is invalid Python syntax -- evaluates to just 'int'. Should be 'tuple[Optional[Recipe], int]'.

subtasks.title: Change return annotation to 'tuple[Optional[Recipe], int]'
Run tests

tasks.title: Fix generic.py yield regex -- too narrow capture
tasks.description: Line 44: yield_re pattern '(\d+ \w)' captures only one word character after digit+space. Should be broader like '(\d+\s*\w+)' to match 'Yield: 4 servings'.

subtasks.title: Fix regex to capture full yield string (e.g., '12 servings')
Test with a sample that exercises the generic parser yield extraction

tasks.title: Fix vitt.py character removal mismatch (\u008d vs \u200d)
tasks.description: _extract_instructions() line 475 removes \u008d (REVERSE LINE FEED) but docstring says 'Zero Width Joiner'. Other methods correctly remove \u200d (ZWJ). Likely wrong hex code or wrong comment.

subtasks.title: Determine correct behavior: should it remove \u008d, \u200d, or both?
Fix code or docstring to match intended behavior
Run tests and regenerate expected output if needed
